description: This file contains power management functions for STM32WBA microcontrollers within Zephyr OS, including cache control, power mode transitions, suspend to RAM, and system initialization.

methods.name: disable_cache
methods.description: Disables instruction cache (ICACHE) and waits until it is fully disabled.

methods.name: set_mode_stop
methods.description: Sets the system to stop mode (STOP0 or STOP1) based on substate_id, after disabling cache and clearing flags.

methods.name: suspend_to_ram
methods.description: Prepares system for suspend to RAM by enabling deep sleep and entering low power mode.

methods.name: set_mode_suspend_to_ram
methods.description: Configures system to enter standby mode with SRAM retention and wakeup pin, then suspends.

methods.name: pm_state_set
methods.description: Sets the power management state (e.g., suspend to idle or suspend to RAM) based on parameters.

methods.name: pm_state_exit_post_ops
methods.description: Performs post-exit operations after waking from low power modes, restoring caches, clocks, and system state.

methods.name: stm32_power_init
methods.description: Initializes power management features for STM32, including debug and low power modes.
